Title: John Deere S120 Mower 42 in. 22 HP V-Twin Gas Hydrostatic Riding Lawn Mower
Body (HTML):
the John Deere S120 riding lawn mower is the premium 42 in. deck model of the 100 series line up. You'll experience more power and smoother operation with a John Deere branded Briggs & Stratton 22 HP V-Twin engine. The ergonomic design of the operator's station is wide and comfortable. Side-by-side foot pedals easily control the speed and direction of travel, while the cruise control provides a constant mowing speed, good for mowing larger properties. The 42 in. Edge mower deck is time-tested and, with its deep deck design, proven to offer superior cut quality. This mower can easily be equipped to bag or mulch. For easy serviceability, the S120 offers the industry exclusive John Deere Easy Change 30-Second Oil Change System.
